description: Sends ONE transactional email (a receipt, a reply, a booking confirmation) to one address right away. Not reversible, and it uses one email of quota. Never use it for marketing or to mail a list: campaigns are for that. Show the person the recipient, subject and body and get a yes before calling, then pass confirm: true. idempotency_key is required: reuse the same key if you retry so the email is not sent twice. Pass html, text, or both. Requires API key scope: send.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the person explicitly approved this exact recipient, subject and body. Never set it on a guess.

html.description: HTML body (at most 200,000 characters). Hollerpost adds the brand header.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this email, for example "receipt-1042". Reusing it returns the first result instead of sending again.

reply_to.description: Reply-to address, if different from the workspace default.

name: email_send
title: Send transactional email
